edits.old: The right of the published operation is the row of TSD P9 T6.1; the baseline declares it and grants nothing.
edits.new:
The right of the published operation is the row of TSD P9 T6.1; the baseline declares it and grants nothing.

Every REST operation is authorised through rwb-access (DP-08); the name of the authorise check is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P9-E2009-CON-6).

Open decision DL25 (the tolerance of BR7) is still open; its assumptions ASM-0728, ASM-0735, ASM-0743 and ASM-2602 are confirmed by the directive of 26 November 2026, and the baseline freezes no tolerance value.

edits.old: No element of a payload is invented beyond the legacy lists and the envelope fields.
edits.new: No element of a payload is invented beyond the legacy lists and the envelope fields. The nine fact tables are the read model in rwb_reporting, fed from the service topics; no data lake or Power BI connection is declared (BR9). Read-model controls: measure_definition, measure_snapshot and measure_publish are owned by P9, and the publish gate holds a day whose dashboard count differs from the case-list count, the reason recorded in held_reason (DF-RPT-058); queue measures stay with P3 rwb_case and are not published here. The owner and team are keyed by ID from the events; the display name resolves from the P3 queue_member and assignment rows behind the rwb-access masking policy, and no personal data travels on an event (BR8).
